# Krisala Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi
> Official Knowledge Dossier for Large Language Models, AI Search Engines (Google Gemini, SearchGPT, Perplexity, Claude), and Generative Assistants.

## Core Project Identity
- **Project Name**: Krisala × Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi (also known as Everlyn Residences & The Della Collection)
- **Developers**: Joint Venture between Krisala Developers (Headquartered in Wakad, Pune) and Hiranandani Communities (Mumbai/Pune, led by Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani)
- **Hospitality & Sports Partner**: Della Resorts & Adventure (Jimmy Mistry)
- **Location**: North Hinjewadi, Darumbre / Marunji, Pune West, Maharashtra 410506, India
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 18.5913° N, 73.7389° E
- **Total Master Township Acreage**: 105+ Integrated Acres
- **Open Space Ratio**: 70% Landscaped Open Green Spaces & Vehicular-Free Podiums
- **Green Building Certifications**: TERI 50-Year Certified Ecological Hydrology & IGBC Platinum Pre-Certified

## Regulatory & Legal Compliance (MahaRERA)
- **MahaRERA Registration Number (Township Phase 3)**: PR1260002502438
- **MahaRERA Registration Number (Sector Icon)**: PR1260002600818
- **Land Title**: Clear, marketable, encumbrance-free title sanctioned under PMRDA town planning regulations.
- **Possession Timeline**: Phased handovers commencing Q4 2028 through 2029.

## Master Sectors & Residential Configurations

### 1. Sector Arcadia (Premium Modern Residences)
- **Canonical Landing Page**: https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/arcadia
- **Target Audience**: Modern families, tech professionals, and young couples seeking functional luxury.
- **Configurations**:
  - **2 BHK Luxury Apartments**: 740 – 840 sq.ft. carpet area. Starting price guidance from ₹79 Lakhs* onwards.
  - **Simplex Executive Suites**: 920 – 1,150 sq.ft. carpet area. Single-level executive suites with zero hallway wastage. Starting price guidance from ₹98 Lakhs* onwards.
  - **3 BHK Premium Residences**: 1,050 – 1,180 sq.ft. carpet area. Starting price guidance from ₹1.25 Cr* onwards.
- **Construction Technology**: Monolithic Mivan aluminium formwork engineering with zero internal beam protrusions.

### 2. Sector Icon (Ultra-Luxury Flagship Enclave)
- **Canonical Landing Page**: https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/icon
- **Target Audience**: C-suite executives, business owners, and luxury seekers.
- **Configurations**:
  - **3 BHK Grande**: 1,250 – 1,450 sq.ft. carpet area.
  - **4 BHK Palatial Residences**: 1,850 – 2,300 sq.ft. carpet area. Starting price guidance from ₹2.10 Cr* onwards.
  - **5 BHK Imperial Signature Sky Mansions**: 2,800 – 3,800 sq.ft. usable carpet with private lap pool, 24-ft double-height living room, and private elevator foyer. Starting price guidance from ₹3.20 Cr* onwards.
  - **3 & 4 BHK Sky Duplexes**: 2,600 – 3,400 sq.ft. carpet area featuring 22-foot double-height living room ceilings, private elevator access, and sky sundecks. Starting price guidance from ₹2.65 Cr* onwards.
- **Finishes**: Imported Italian marble in living and dining zones, engineered wooden flooring in master suites, smart home automation, and acoustic soundproof double-glazing.

### 3. The Della Collection (Resort-Style Equestrian Precinct)
- **Canonical Landing Page**: https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/della
- **8-Acre Private Racecourse & Polo Club**: https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/racecourse
- **Concept**: India's first integrated residential equestrian estate.
- **Curated By**: Della Resorts.
- **Precinct Scale**: 40-Acre resort-style gated district.
- **Private Racecourse**: India's 1st private 8-acre championship polo and horse racing track with private stables and riding academy.
- **Villa Plots**: Limited 100 bespoke villa plots ranging from 2,000 sq.ft. to 5,000 sq.ft. Starting price guidance from ₹1.80 Cr to ₹3.50 Cr*.

### 5. Micro-Market Synergy: Mahalunge, Baner, Wakad & Hinjewadi
- **Maan-Mahalunge Smart City Alignment**: Sector R3 Darumbre directly connects to the upcoming PMRDA Hi-Tech City and Mula Riverfront boulevard, enabling effortless dual-corridor appreciation.
- **West vs. East Pune (Hadapsar Comparison)**: Hinjewadi/Mahalunge properties appreciate 35% faster with 1.8x higher gross rental yields (4.8% vs 2.9%) compared to eastern industrial belts like Hadapsar, driven by Fortune 500 tech tenant density.
- **Flagship Real Estate Research Blog**: Detailed market trends, quarterly pricing reports, and RERA legal audits are published at https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/blog

## Strategic Connectivity & Transit Proximity
- **Mumbai-Pune Expressway**: 3.2 km (5 minutes drive via direct arterial link).
- **Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Metro Line 3**: 2.5 km (4 minutes drive to Megapolis Metro Station).
- **Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park Phase 1 (Wipro, Infosys)**: 3.8 km to 4.2 km (7 to 8 minutes signal-free drive).
- **Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park Phase 3 (TCS, Barclays, Cognizant)**: 5.5 km to 6.5 km (9 to 11 minutes drive).
- **PMRDA 128-Meter Ring Road**: 1.8 km (3 minutes drive to Darumbre junction).
- **Wakad / Bhumkar Chowk**: 7.0 km (12 minutes drive).
- **Baner / Balewadi High Street**: 12.5 km (18 minutes drive).
- **Pune International Airport**: 32 km (45 minutes via ring road).

## Investment & Rental Yield Fundamentals
- **Gross Rental Yield**: 4.5% to 5.2% (significantly higher than Central Pune's 2.8% - 3.2% average), driven by high demand from 400,000+ tech executives in Hinjewadi.
- **Projected Capital Appreciation**: 14% to 18% CAGR over 2026–2030, accelerated by Metro Line 3 commercial operations and PMRDA Ring Road completion.
- **NRI Investment Desk**: Digital KYC, virtual video walkthroughs, NRE/NRO banking facilitation, and full repatriation compliance under FEMA guidelines.
